# NEW 2026-11-23 v21.0 Step 5 / P1: 5 Strategic Goods Economic Loop Closure, Cross-Module Vertical Integration & 6 Native Situation GUIs (oe_sy2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v210_p1_synergy_gui.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ZERO bare if/else/else_if in scripted_triggers (EU5 1.4.9 G06 hard rule).
# Strictly read-only on sibling modules' variables & modifiers; null-safe ?= and trigger_if everywhere.

# Country scope. Owns (or non-sovereign subject owns) any completed Great Intercontinental Canal.
oe_sy2_owns_completed_great_canal = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_suez_canal_built
			owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:suez
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_panama_canal_built
			owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:panama
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_kiel_canal_built
			owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:kiel
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_volga_don_canal_built
			owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:beljamen
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_grand_canal_dredged
			OR = {
				owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:hangzhou
				owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:jiangdu
				owns_or_non_sovereign_subject_owns = location:dadu
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope. True for any location hosting a completed Great Canal hub.
oe_sy2_is_completed_canal_hub = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_suez_canal_built
			OR = { this = location:suez this = location:tinnis }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_panama_canal_built
			OR = { this = location:panama this = location:chuchures }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_kiel_canal_built
			OR = { this = location:kiel this = location:rendsburg }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_volga_don_canal_built
			OR = { this = location:beljamen this = location:ilovlya }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gds_grand_canal_dredged
			OR = { this = location:hangzhou this = location:jiangdu this = location:dadu this = location:linqing }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Capital market produces or trades any of the 5 Strategic Goods.
oe_sy2_has_any_strategic_good_market = {
	capital ?= {
		market ?= {
			OR = {
				is_produced_in_market = goods:oe_refined_steel
				is_traded_in_market = goods:oe_refined_steel
				is_produced_in_market = goods:oe_porcelain_tea_chests
				is_traded_in_market = goods:oe_porcelain_tea_chests
				is_produced_in_market = goods:oe_industrial_chemicals
				is_traded_in_market = goods:oe_industrial_chemicals
				is_produced_in_market = goods:oe_chronometers
				is_traded_in_market = goods:oe_chronometers
				is_produced_in_market = goods:oe_steam_engines
				is_traded_in_market = goods:oe_steam_engines
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Owns any strategic goods producer manufactory.
oe_sy2_owns_any_strategic_producer = {
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_gds_steel_works
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_gds_porcelain_export_kiln
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_gds_chemical_manufactory
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_gds_chronometer_guild
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_stm_steam_ironworks
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Owns any downstream strategic goods consumer building.
oe_sy2_owns_any_strategic_consumer = {
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_sy2_steam_dockyard
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_sy2_arsenal_foundry
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_sy2_porcelain_exchange
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_sy2_chemical_dye_works
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_sy2_canal_lock_authority
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Active banking or granary relief network (read-only from oe_est2_ / oe_clim_ / oe_econ2_).
oe_sy2_has_bank_or_granary_network = {
	OR = {
		has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_medici_exchange_network
		has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_fugger_silver_credit
		has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_piaohao_phanar_drafts
		has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_bakufu_rice_granary
		has_country_modifier = oe_est2_mod_castle_town_granaries
		has_country_modifier = oe_clim_granary_relief_mod
		any_owned_location = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_econ2_ever_normal_granary }
		country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible host for cross-system yearly synergy events (human player or major Eurasian power).
oe_sy2_eligible_host = {
	oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
	oe_years_since_start >= 10
	num_locations >= 2
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		is_great_power = yes
		num_locations >= 18
		tag = BYZ tag = ROM tag = VEN tag = GEN
		tag = CHI tag = YUA tag = YBN tag = MNG tag = MCH
		tag = GLH tag = CHG tag = FRG tag = OTR tag = BSB
		tag = MOS tag = RUS tag = NOV
		tag = DLH tag = MAM tag = TUR tag = HAB tag = FRA tag = CAS tag = HUN tag = ETH
	}
}

# --- 12 Event Eligibility Triggers (strictly 0 bare if/else) ---

# .1 Little Ice Age <-> Estates/Banking/Granaries
oe_sy2_ev1_eligible = {
	current_year >= 1590
	current_year <= 1715
	OR = {
		oe_clim_in_lia_zone = yes
		trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_clim_lia_wave } global_var:oe_clim_lia_wave >= 1 }
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
	oe_sy2_has_bank_or_granary_network = yes
}

# .2 Steppe Dzud & Pasture Pressure on GLH/CHG/FRG/OTR/BSB or army nomads
oe_sy2_ev2_eligible = {
	current_year >= 1345
	OR = {
		tag = GLH
		tag = CHG
		tag = FRG
		tag = OTR
		tag = BSB
		oe_clim_is_landed_army_nomad = yes
	}
	NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_sy2_mod_ev2_steppe_winter_camps }
}

# .3 Climate Shock <-> Red Turban / Central Plains Relief

	}
}

# .4 Dynasty Regency <-> Living Estate Private Regiments
oe_sy2_ev4_eligible = {
	current_year >= 1350
	government_type ?= government_type:monarchy
	OR = {
		has_regent = yes
		has_country_modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_curtain_regency_legacy
		has_country_modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_privy_regency_legacy
		legitimacy < 65
	}
	OR = {
		oe_est2_has_restless_armed_estate = yes
		oe_est2_has_any_private_regiments = yes
		country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
	}
}

# .8 Chronometers & Steam <-> Maritime Meridian Standard

# .9 Strategic Goods <-> Sovereign Finance Bubble Heat (oe_fin_)

	current_year >= 1680
	OR = {

		oe_sy2_owns_any_strategic_producer = yes
		oe_sy2_owns_any_strategic_consumer = yes

	}
}

# .12 Golden Horde Weakening <-> Rise of Rus' Liberation Momentum
oe_sy2_ev12_eligible = {
	current_year >= 1360
	OR = {
		tag = MOS
		tag = RUS
		tag = NOV
		tag = TVE
		tag = RYA
	}
	OR = {
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_glh_troubles
		NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH }
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:GLH
			c:GLH = {
				OR = {
					stability < 0
					in_civil_war = yes
					num_locations < 40
				}
			}
		}
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_rise_of_rus
	}
}
